sources.title: General-purpose robot foundation model (Pi0) #
sources.snippet: Pi0 created by Physical Intelligence introduces a groundbreaking robotic model designed to integrate vision, language, and action (VLA) for general-purpose robotic tasks.

sources.title: pi0 Architecture — Interactive 3D Visual Guide | Vizuara
sources.snippet: Explore the pi0 robot foundation model architecture through interactive 3D visualizations. Visual encoding, VLM backbone, flow matching, and attention assembly.

sources.title: 𝜋_0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
sources.snippet: By basing our model on a VLM, we inherit the general knowledge, semantic reasoning, and problem-solving abilities of language- and vision-language models. We then further train our model to incorporate robot actions, turning it into a vision-language-action (VLA) model [7].

sources.title: Physical Intelligence (π)
sources.snippet: Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing learning algorithms to create a model that will control any robot to do any task.
